thread:
Zara (Sales): handing off HarborCare to CS. 3-month pilot, 3 seats, EU data residency required. They want Okta SSO, Splunk log forwarding, and a private eval in eu-west. Renewal around 11 months. Omar, can you take point? Contract: https://redwood.at/harborcare-pilot

Omar (CS): happy to. Quick clarifying q: who	's the technical lead and do they expect any PHI during pilot? Need to surface compliance risks early.

Zara (Sales): tech lead is "Leah Park" (leah@harborcare.io). They say pilot will be synthetic/dev data only (no PHI) but asked about HIPAA controls for future. Flag security.

Ibrahim (Infra): for private eval we need their CIDRs, peering method (VPC peering or transit gateway), and client cert for mTLS. Splunk HEC requires outbound to splunk.collector.harborcare.io:8088 and their HEC token.

Nikki (Support Eng): Splunk prefers JSON events. I'll draft a mapping for audit->splunk and a short troubleshooting checklist (token issues, cert chain, firewall). Also note token rotation cadence.

Tess (Onboarding PM): I can schedule kickoff. I suggest 30-min tech kickoff + 45-min enablement. Morning CET works. Omar, want Tue/Wed next week?

Omar (CS): Tue works. Proposed owners:
- Leah / HarborCare -> supply CIDRs + cert + Splunk token
- Zara -> confirm SSO metadata (Okta org + IdP cert)
- Ibrahim -> provision private eval (eu-west) (will open infra ticket once assets arrive)
- Nikki -> prepare runbook + troubleshooting checklist
- Tess -> schedule kickoff + prep enablement materials

Zara (Sales): adding context: they care about RBAC and audit exports. Also requested ability to export logs to their S3 in EU. Tag security/compliance.

Ibrahim (Infra): infra note: once CIDRs & cert present, creating ticket INF-9412 to provision private eval eu-west. Minimal instance size m8g unless they ask for Dedicated.

ops-bot: INF-9412 created: provision-private-eval-harborcare (assigned: Ibrahim)

Nikki (Support Eng): I'll include S3->Splunk export option in the runbook and show sample JSON payload. Will post link when ready.

Omar (CS): I'll create the pilot feedback doc (owner: Omar) with quick NPS + 4 workflow checks and add renewal owner (Zara) to Gainsight with reminder at month 9. I'll send Leah a summary email after this thread.

Tess (Onboarding PM): I'll send two times for Tue morning CET and include a 15-min pre-kickoff for infra if needed.

Zara (Sales): pinged Leah; she said assets will be in by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Omar (CS): great. Final checklist in thread: Leah to send assets; Ibrahim to update INF-9412; Tess to schedule invites; Nikki to post runbook; Omar to publish pilot doc & CRM notes. I'll follow up with an email. :white_check_mark:
